publisherMetadata.scienceTeam: A. Parker and M. Buie (Southwest Research Institute), W. Grundy (Lowell Observatory), K. Noll (NASA Goddard Space Flight Center)

inspection: Non-annotated monochrome publisher scene: small faint point above bright Makemake with diffraction/glare and background noise. JPEG inspected; TIFF decoded successfully. Artist concepts are separate products and have not been adopted as native science.
limitations: Unresolved detection does not establish resolved terrain, axes, chemistry, calibrated visible colour or geography. Makemake glare/diffraction are not moon morphology. Black background is not an atmosphere-absence measurement.
Publisher 100-mile moon diameter is a caption estimate, not a new raster calculation or measured local material fraction; independent size/albedo assumptions require primary audit.
The metadata lists April 27/29 and a combined exposure time; exact image exposure association, UTCs, coaddition, processing and raw product crosswalk remain open.
No map belonging to Makemake or another observed body is assigned to its moon. Rotation, orbit, shape, composition, local normal and dated observer geometry remain open.
No claim of exhaustive newest imagery, solid-ground survivability, ocean, plume or biology. No angular/raster calculation performed.
